interpretation: The published Ursino peripheral O2 response and native HumMod chemoreceptor response have the same strong monotonic hypoxia response before CNS failure.
Native HumMod downstream sympathetic and SA-node activation is much smaller than the afferent chemoreceptor change in this challenge.
At brain-function failure the native SympsCNS and vagal outputs reset toward their fallback state while the published O2 afferent/CNS-hypoxia shadow states continue to reflect profound hypoxia.
This comparison does not authorize substitution of Ursino efferents because f_ab is not yet source-mapped and the 2001 O2-CO2 interaction remains blocked.
